# Hello World Application

## Requirements

- The application must start successfully.
- When started, the application must display `Hello, World!`.
- Must also output date and time in UTC

All listed requirements are business-level behaviors that do not necessitate the creation or management of persistent data entities or relationships. The application must start, display a greeting, and output the current UTC date/time, which are transient actions. No requirement specifies storing, retrieving, or relating data, so entity records are unnecessary.
